mostWorthwhile.text: Correcting the misheard request and linking it to its source was most worthwhile: it connected a concrete AI error to a checkable repair decision.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sign repair was pleasant but predictable; connecting the cleared motor, lead and sign offered few meaningful choices.

surprise.text: Moth confidently turned train noise into a plausible but wrong computer-repair request; the correction revealed that the job was cooling.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. Preparing and loading the source display were separate steps, but their purpose was clear.

continue.text: Yes. The combination of concrete repairs, neighborhood stakes and Moth's correctable mistakes makes me curious what happens next, even if some combinations are straightforward.
